OUT = Path("/app/output")

def joint_now(obs):
    return np.asarray(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"][:29], dtype=float)


def target_now(obs):
    return np.asarray(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"][58:87], dtype=float)

    rgb = np.asarray(obs.last[cam])
    dep = np.asarray(obs.depth[cam])
    if dep.ndim == 3:
        dep = dep[-1]
    dep = dep.astype(float)
    cal = obs.meta["cameras"][cam]
    k = np.asarray(cal["intrinsic_cv"], dtype=float)
    t = np.asarray(cal["cam2world_gl"], dtype=float)
    v, u = np.indices(dep.shape)
    p = np.stack(((u - k[0, 2]) * dep / k[0, 0],
                  -(v - k[1, 2]) * dep / k[1, 1],
                  -dep, np.ones_like(dep)), axis=-1)
    xyz = (p @ t.T)[..., :3]
    return rgb, dep, xyz


def palm(obs, near, radius=.20):
    """Median visible white hand surface nearest a predicted 3-D location."""
    rgb, dep, xyz = cloud(obs, "top")
